        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: farm3d/tests/package-lock.json

        working-directory: farm3d/tests
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
        working-directory: farm3d/tests

        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/a52-ci-safe/utility-lights"
          node "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/farm3d/tests/helpers/ci-isolated-runner.cjs" --receipt "$RUNNER_TEMP/a52-ci-safe/utility-lights/step-1.json" --timeout-ms 1200000 --max-output-bytes 16777216 -- bash --noprofile --norc -e -o pipefail -c 'node --test farm3d/tests/save-writer-compatibility.test.mjs farm3d/tests/utility-lights.test.mjs farm3d/tests/decor-models.test.mjs farm3d/tests/decor-save.test.mjs farm3d/tests/holiday-decor.test.mjs farm3d/tests/holiday-clearings.test.mjs farm3d/tests/versions.test.mjs'
